What Each One Is

Edge of the Empire p.16
Physical
BRAWN4Muscle & Toughness

Brawn is raw physical power. It drives Athletics and Brawl, and it sets two of your derived stats: your soak (the damage you shrug off) and your wound threshold.

AGILITY2Speed & Precision

Agility is coordination and dexterity. It powers Coordination and is the key stat for ranged combat: Ranged (Light) and Ranged (Heavy).

Mental
INTELLECT2Reason & Education

Intellect is book-learning and analysis. It powers Astrogation, Computers, and every Knowledge skill.

CUNNING2Guile & Instinct

Cunning is street-smarts and craftiness. It powers Deception, Perception, and Survival.

Personality & force of spirit
WILLPOWER2Discipline & Nerve

Willpower is self-control and mental fortitude. It powers Coercion and Vigilance, and it sets your strain threshold.

PRESENCE2Charisma & Force of Will

Presence is charm and force of personality. It powers Charm and Leadership, your social spine.
